obfuscation_indicators: inability to quantify certain comparative metrics
risk_summary: The disclosure is highly quantified and transparent about material deterioration, including a 6.5% sales decline, sharply lower operating margin and EPS, goodwill impairment, restructuring costs, and COVID-19-related demand weakness. Risk remains elevated because organic sales were down in the mid-teens entering fiscal 2021, while impairment and fair-value outcomes depend on management judgments and uncertain assumptions.
